dedupe_keys.name: china transpiration and evapotranspiration gridded dataset 1981 2015

description: This OSF project publishes gridded transpiration, evapotranspiration and their ratio for China from 1981 through 2015. The Scientific Data descriptor describes annual and finer temporal NetCDF layers at 0.05-degree resolution, produced by combining a land-surface model with observations. Irrigation, drought or green-infrastructure simulations can use the grids to check vegetation water demand and evapotranspiration assumptions. The ratio is not a direct field measurement, and missing pixels use a sentinel value; regional ratios should be calculated from mean fluxes, not averaging pixel ratios indiscriminately. The own OSF project API names the data and lists public storage, while the DOI registration states CC0. I inspected metadata only, without downloading NetCDF files or running the included MATLAB scripts. The related method code is part of the same OSF project and is not counted as a separate address. No exact catalogue record was found.
